title: Pan-Seared Wild Mushrooms with Savory Leaves
description: A simple and flavorful Japanese-inspired dish featuring the earthy taste of wild mushrooms and savory leaves. Perfect for a quick dinner or lunch.
instructions: Heat a non-stick pan over medium-high heat.
Add 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and 1 tablespoon of rice vinegar to the pan.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the wild mushrooms and cook for 3-4 minutes, until they start to brown.
Add the savory leaves and cook for another 2-3 minutes, until wilted.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Garnish with green onions and serve immediately.
